title: Production & LLMOps
summary: Run AI systems reliably at an acceptable unit cost: deployment shapes, reliability patterns, monitoring, cost engineering, and incidents.
outcomes: Choose a deployment shape and manage versioned prompts, models, and configs
Apply reliability patterns: timeouts, fallbacks, circuit breakers, graceful degradation
Run to SLOs and a cost budget with dashboards and alerts
Handle incidents and roll back safely

lessons.title: Incidents, rollback, and the improvement loop
